description.en: Enterprise fiscal intelligence and ERP bridge platform processing millions of electronic tax documents (NFC-e / NF-e) daily. Core backend with Spring Data JDBC, Tauri 2 (Rust) + Apache Pulsar desktop-to-cloud bridge, and disk-virtualized JasperReports.
description.pt: Plataforma de inteligência fiscal e ponte de ERP corporativo processando milhões de documentos eletrônicos (NFC-e / NF-e) por dia. Backend em Spring Data JDBC, ponte desktop-nuvem em Tauri 2 (Rust) + Apache Pulsar e relatórios virtualizados em JasperReports.
description.fr: Plateforme d'intelligence fiscale et passerelle ERP d'entreprise traitant des millions de documents électroniques par jour. Spring Data JDBC, passerelle desktop-cloud Tauri 2 (Rust) + Apache Pulsar et JasperReports.
